verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document at supabase.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), so a machine-readable spec exists on the vendor's site. Nothing in the evidence shows that this spec covers the Supabase Auth endpoints rather than another Supabase API. The llms.txt and markdown docs are related machine-readable resources, not API specs. Missing for 10: confirmation that the spec documents the Auth API, first-party docs describing the spec and how to download it, and independent or hands-on corroboration of its use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://supabase.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
